item.title: Zero API Fees, No Beefy PC: How We Rebuilt a Viral Japanese AI Video Workflow with ChatGPT + inkloom.im
item.description: A Japanese AI film festival award winner built a text-to-video workflow with zero API fees and no local GPU. We ran his three Floyo workflows through ChatGPT, turned them into structured prompt cards, and published them on inkloom.im — copy, paste, and generate. A hands-on case study in prompt cleanup and distribution.
